description: Recurring Question Archetypes in GATE DA 2024-2026 with frequency, marks, and solution patterns

A1_Bayesian_Inference.name: Bayesian Inference / Conditional Probability
A1_Bayesian_Inference.common_trap: Confusing P(A|B) with P(B|A); forgetting denominator in Bayes
A1_Bayesian_Inference.fastest_method: Tree diagram or direct formula; compute P(evidence) via law of total probability

A2_Relational_Algebra_SQL.name: Relational Algebra & Nested SQL
A2_Relational_Algebra_SQL.common_trap: Wrong operator order (σ before π); Cartesian product explosion; correlated subquery scope
A2_Relational_Algebra_SQL.fastest_method: Inside-out evaluation; push selections down; verify schema at each step

A3_Python_Mutable_Scope.name: Python Mutable Default Argument / Closure / Scope Tracing
A3_Python_Mutable_Scope.common_trap: Assuming default [] resets each call; missing nonlocal; aliasing across scopes
A3_Python_Mutable_Scope.fastest_method: Draw memory state table; trace each call explicitly; defaults evaluated ONCE at definition

A4_PCA_Eigen_Properties.name: PCA / Eigen-decomposition Properties
A4_PCA_Eigen_Properties.common_trap: Computing full eigen-decomposition; forgetting PCs are orthogonal; confusing variance with eigenvalue
A4_PCA_Eigen_Properties.fastest_method: Use properties: PCs orthogonal (90°); sum of eigenvalues = trace; rank-1 matrix has one non-zero eigenvalue

A5_Alpha_Beta_Pruning.name: Alpha-Beta Pruning Bounds
A5_Alpha_Beta_Pruning.common_trap: Losing track of MAX/MIN levels; incorrect bound propagation; asymmetrical trees
A5_Alpha_Beta_Pruning.fastest_method: Write MAX/MIN at each node; track [α,β] passed down; prune when α ≥ β

A6_Probability_Density_Geometry.name: Probability Density Geometric Integrals (2D)
A6_Probability_Density_Geometry.common_trap: Integrating over rectangular bounds instead of dependent region (e.g., 0<y<x); wrong limits
A6_Probability_Density_Geometry.fastest_method: DRAW the region; set up dependent limits; integrate inner variable first

A7_SVM_Geometric_Margins.name: SVM Geometric Margins
A7_SVM_Geometric_Margins.common_trap: Using Lagrangian algebra instead of geometry; wrong support vector identification
A7_SVM_Geometric_Margins.fastest_method: PLOT points; find separating hyperplane by inspection; margin = 2/||w||; SVs = closest points

A8_Distance_Metric_Clustering.name: Distance Metric Clustering (k-Means / Hierarchical)
A8_Distance_Metric_Clustering.common_trap: Confusing single vs complete linkage; wrong distance metric; Voronoi boundary errors
A8_Distance_Metric_Clustering.fastest_method: Compute pairwise distances; for hierarchical, build merge tree step by step

A9_Neural_Architecture_Params.name: Neural Architecture Parameter Counting
A9_Neural_Architecture_Params.common_trap: Forgetting biases; wrong layer multiplication order
A9_Neural_Architecture_Params.fastest_method: Sum of (n_i × n_{i+1}) for weights + sum of n_{i+1} for biases; if no bias, just weights

A10_BPlus_Tree_Capacity.name: B+ Tree Structural Capacity
A10_BPlus_Tree_Capacity.common_trap: Wrong formula for order; confusing leaf vs internal node capacity
A10_BPlus_Tree_Capacity.fastest_method: Order = floor(BlockSize / (KeySize + PointerSize)) + 1; max pointers = order

A11_Implicit_Projection_Matrix.name: The Implicit Projection / Centering Matrix (I - 1/n 11^T)
A11_Implicit_Projection_Matrix.common_trap: Attempting algebraic expansion; confusing M²=M (projection) with M²=I (involution); trace = n-1 not n
A11_Implicit_Projection_Matrix.fastest_method: RECOGNIZE the pattern: I - (1/n)11^T = centering matrix = projection → M²=M, symmetric, eigenvalues {0,1,1...}, trace=n-1

A12_Bias_Variance_Tradeoff.name: Bias-Variance Tradeoff (Hyperparameter Effects)
A12_Bias_Variance_Tradeoff.common_trap: Confusing direction: larger k in k-NN increases bias; larger depth decreases bias
A12_Bias_Variance_Tradeoff.fastest_method: Memorize: complexity↑ → variance↑, bias↓; regularization↑ → bias↑, variance↓

A13_Gradient_Descent_Mechanics.name: Gradient Descent Mechanics (Weight Updates)
A13_Gradient_Descent_Mechanics.common_trap: Matrix dimension mismatch; forgetting chain rule through ReLU; wrong learning rate application
A13_Gradient_Descent_Mechanics.fastest_method: w_new = w - η × ∇L; for ReLU, derivative is 1 if input>0 else 0; track dimensions carefully

A14_Graph_Reachability.name: Graph Reachability (BFS/DFS/Reverse Graph)
A14_Graph_Reachability.common_trap: Confusing forward vs reverse reachability; missing directed edges
A14_Graph_Reachability.fastest_method: Trace on paper; for reverse graph, flip all edges; BFS=shortest path in unweighted

A15_Decision_Tree_Entropy.name: Decision Tree Entropy / Information Gain
A15_Decision_Tree_Entropy.common_trap: Log base 2 errors; weighted entropy calculation; splitting on wrong attribute
A15_Decision_Tree_Entropy.fastest_method: H = -Σ p log₂ p; IG = H(parent) - Σ (|child|/|parent|) H(child); compute carefully

A16_Sorting_Behaviour_Analysis.name: Sorting Behaviour Analysis (Exact Counts)
A16_Sorting_Behaviour_Analysis.common_trap: Counting comparisons vs swaps; assuming standard case instead of specific input
A16_Sorting_Behaviour_Analysis.fastest_method: Trace the EXACT algorithm on the GIVEN input; don't use average-case formulas
prerequisites: Bubble, Insertion, Selection, Quick, Merge sort mechanics

A17_Hashing_Collision_Resolution.name: Hashing Collision Resolution (Linear/Quadratic Probing)
A17_Hashing_Collision_Resolution.common_trap: Wrong probe sequence; off-by-one in modular arithmetic
A17_Hashing_Collision_Resolution.fastest_method: Simulate insertions step by step; track table state

A18_Functional_Dependency_Inference.name: Functional Dependency Inference (Keys, Closure, BCNF)
A18_Functional_Dependency_Inference.common_trap: Missing extraneous attributes; wrong closure computation; confusing candidate key with superkey
A18_Functional_Dependency_Inference.fastest_method: Compute attribute closures systematically; check BCNF: every determinant must be superkey

A19_Predicate_Logic_Translation.name: Predicate Logic Translation (Natural Language → FOL)
A19_Predicate_Logic_Translation.common_trap: Using ∧ instead of → in universal quantification (∀x King(x) ∧ Person(x) is WRONG); scope errors
A19_Predicate_Logic_Translation.fastest_method: Template: 'All A are B' → ∀x (A(x) → B(x)); 'Some A are B' → ∃x (A(x) ∧ B(x))

A20_Regression_Regularization.name: Regression Regularization (L1/L2 Geometry)
A20_Regression_Regularization.common_trap: Ridge drives weights to ZERO (FALSE - that's Lasso); MAE vs MSE in Ridge loss (2026 Q55 DEADLY TRAP)
A20_Regression_Regularization.fastest_method: L1 (Lasso) → sparsity (exact zeros); L2 (Ridge) → shrinkage (small but non-zero); READ the loss function GIVEN
prerequisites: Geometry of L1 vs L2 balls

A21_Normalization.name: Normalization (1NF to BCNF)
A21_Normalization.common_trap: Confusing 2NF/3NF/BCNF boundaries; partial vs transitive dependency
A21_Normalization.fastest_method: Find all candidate keys; check each FD: if LHS not superkey → violation; highest normal form = lowest satisfied

A22_Minimax_Reasoning.name: Minimax Reasoning (Game Trees)
A22_Minimax_Reasoning.common_trap: Wrong MAX/MIN assignment at root; losing track of which player moves
A22_Minimax_Reasoning.fastest_method: Label every node MAX/MIN; compute bottom-up; write values at each node

A23_Distribution_Properties.name: Distribution Properties (Poisson, Exponential, Normal)
A23_Distribution_Properties.common_trap: Forgetting mean=variance for Poisson; memoryless property only for Exponential/Geometric
A23_Distribution_Properties.fastest_method: Memorize: Poisson(λ): μ=σ²=λ; Exponential: memoryless P(X>s+t|X>s)=P(X>t); Normal: linear transform

A24_Search_Heuristic_Analysis.name: Search Heuristic Analysis (A* Admissibility/Consistency)
A24_Search_Heuristic_Analysis.common_trap: Confusing admissible (h ≤ h*) with consistent (triangle inequality); expansion order errors
A24_Search_Heuristic_Analysis.fastest_method: Admissible: never overestimates; Consistent: h(n) ≤ c(n,n') + h(n'); f(n)=g(n)+h(n) for expansion order

A25_Hypothesis_Testing_Logic.name: Hypothesis Testing Logic (Type I/II, p-value, CI)
A25_Hypothesis_Testing_Logic.common_trap: Confusing Type I (α) with Type II (β); p-value ≠ P(H0 true); CI interpretation
A25_Hypothesis_Testing_Logic.fastest_method: Type I = reject true H0; Type II = accept false H0; p-value = P(data | H0); 95% CI: if repeat, 95% contain true param
